meta.themes: Agentic Commerce, AI Governance, Coding Agents, AI Infrastructure

news.title: Anthropic launched Claude Opus 4.8 with dynamic workflows
news.summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8 with stronger coding and agentic performance, Claude Code dynamic workflows for hundreds of parallel subagents, effort controls, and unchanged standard API pricing.

news.title: Anthropic raised $65B at a $965B post-money valuation
news.summary: Anthropic announced a $65 billion Series H led by major investors and infrastructure partners, saying the funding will expand compute, safety research, and Claude product capacity.

news.title: OpenAI published a Frontier Governance Framework
news.summary: OpenAI published a framework mapping its safety and security practices to emerging obligations including California's frontier AI transparency law and the EU AI Act code of practice.

news.title: OpenAI signed its first Brazil media partnership
news.summary: OpenAI partnered with Grupo Folha and Grupo UOL to bring attributed Brazilian journalism into ChatGPT while giving the publishers access to Codex, ChatGPT Enterprise, and the API.

news.title: NVIDIA framed GTC Taipei around AI factories and Vera Rubin
news.summary: NVIDIA's GTC Taipei updates highlighted Taiwan's AI infrastructure ecosystem, Vera Rubin NVL72, and Huang's view that AI has turned computing into national and enterprise infrastructure.

news.title: Google Pay prepared merchants for agentic commerce
news.summary: Google said existing Google Pay backends and merchant IDs are compatible with its Universal Commerce Protocol and previewed agent-facing tools for future AI-powered shopping flows.

news.title: Google launched a Pay and Wallet Developer MCP server
news.summary: Google introduced a Model Context Protocol server that lets AI assistants query Pay and Wallet documentation, validate Wallet pass payloads, manage integrations, and inspect merchant performance.

news.title: Claude Opus 4.8 became available in GitHub Copilot
news.summary: GitHub made Claude Opus 4.8 available across Copilot surfaces including VS Code, Copilot CLI, cloud agent, GitHub Mobile, JetBrains, Xcode, Eclipse, and github.com.

news.title: GitHub Copilot metrics added AI adoption cohorts
news.summary: GitHub's Copilot usage metrics API now classifies engaged users into code-first, agent-first, and multi-agent adoption phases across a rolling 28-day window.

news.title: Copilot Memory added deletion, scope, and CLI controls
news.summary: GitHub expanded Copilot Memory governance with clearer deletion guidance, repository-level disablement, explicit capture scope, and a new /memory command in Copilot CLI.

news.title: GitHub added targeted Copilot model rules
news.summary: GitHub introduced public-preview model rules so Copilot Business and Enterprise owners can allow specific Copilot models for selected organizations instead of using one enterprise-wide setting.

news.title: NIST broadened its AI consortium around measurement and adoption
news.summary: NIST renamed the former AI Safety Institute Consortium as the NIST AI Consortium, expanded it into six task groups, and invited new members to support AI measurement science.
